# Brain Games Publishing

> > Brain Games Publishing is a board game and puzzle publisher offering strategic family games, party games, and logic puzzles including flagship titles ICECOOL and Flow.

Brain Games Publishing, based in Riga, Latvia, specializes in designing and publishing innovative board games and puzzles for families, kids, and party settings. Their product portfolio includes award-winning titles like ICECOOL, Flow, and various card games and brain teasers.

## Game Collections

- [Board Games](https://brain-games.com/collections/all-games): Complete board games catalog featuring ICECOOL, Flow, and other titles.
- [Family Board Games](https://brain-games.com/collections/family-games): Family-friendly board games collection with ICECOOL and Flow series.
- [Kids Board Games](https://brain-games.com/collections/kids-games): Kids board games collection including ICECOOL and Flow products.
- [Party Board Games](https://brain-games.com/collections/party-games): Party games collection including TEAM3 and Mimic Octopus titles.
- [Card Games](https://brain-games.com/collections/card-games): Card games collection featuring Deductio, Karakum, and Game of Trains.
- [Logic Cards & Brain Teasers](https://brain-games.com/collections/brain-teasers): Logic card brain teasers and puzzle games collection.

## Featured Product Lines

- [ICECOOL Universe](https://brain-games.com/collections/icecool-universe): ICECOOL product line including base games, sequels, and expansions.
- [Flow](https://brain-games.com/collections/flow): Flow product line featuring board game and 1000-piece puzzle variants.
- [Flow - The Board Game](https://brain-games.com/products/flow): Flow cooperative board game product page with game details.
- [New Releases](https://brain-games.com/collections/new-releases): Latest board game and puzzle releases including Flow and ICECOOL Wizards.
- [Expansions & Promos](https://brain-games.com/collections/expansions-promos): Game expansions and promotional items for ICECOOL and other titles.
